+init() {
+	SCRIPT_DIR="$(dirname "$0")"
+}
+
+determine_download_tool() {
+	if [ -n "$(command -v curl)" ]; then
+		CMD="curl -fsSL"
+	elif [ -n "$(command -v wget)" ]; then
+		CMD="wget -O- -q"
+	else
+		echo "no downloader found! Please install either wget or curl." 1>&2
+		exit 1
+	fi
+}
+
+execute() {
+	if [ $DRY_RUN -eq 1 ]; then
+		echo $CMDLINE
+	else
+		echo $CMDLINE >&2
+		$CMDLINE
+	fi
+}
+
 main() {
 	init
-	parse_args $@
-	run
+	parse_args "$@"
+	determine_download_tool
+	build_cmdline
+	execute
 }
